CodeLima 1.0.3 fixes the Nodes table layout during setup failures and lifecycle
operations.

- Keep CPU, memory, disk, template and other values under their own headers.
  Failed or unfinished setup no longer replaces resource cells with status text.
- Show the selected node's failure or progress message below the table, with
  the details and logs shortcuts. Compact and wide layouts use the same context.
- Preserve observed metrics while setup has failed. Unavailable samples remain
  explicit as `—`. VM Status and Setup remain separate.

The repair changes presentation only. Existing setup failures retain their
recorded state and retry history.

Upgrade with:

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade codelima
codelima daemon update
codelima --version
```

Reopen the TUI after upgrading. Keep both executables together when installing
a native archive.

Regression coverage includes five terminal widths, failed and unfinished setup,
unavailable samples, retained failures and superseding live operations. Native
macOS row checks also covered grouping, marks, details and logs without changing
the existing VM state. The release workflow verifies and packages Linux amd64,
Linux arm64 and macOS arm64 before publication.

This release retains the existing signing and distribution method. Broader
manual qualification, Developer ID notarization, and the separate chart-gap
and frontend-shutdown investigations remain tracked in TODO.md.
